internationalization_requirements: All UI strings translatable by stable keys; no assumptions about source language
Keep dynamic placeholders/plural forms, date/time/number/units locale aware; preserve machine data UTC/timebase
Keyboard/screen reader announcements and notifications translated where applicable
Do not translate file names, protocol keys, source labels, RF frequency units or internal APIs as if UI text
Separate UI localization from optional speech ASR and translation language models
English is the canonical engineering and documentation language
Verify desktop, tablet, mobile layouts for DE/TR text expansion and accessibility
Add locale selection only in explicit reviewed UI work after baseline parity
